display_long_description:
Have you ever dreamed of shrinking down to explore a tarantula’s lair or share space with scorpions, snakes, and lizards—without ever getting bitten? Creepy Crawly Zoo 2.0 makes this sensational dream a reality! Immerse yourself in actual living habitats through breathtaking macro 360° virtual reality, placing you directly alongside these incredible creatures for unprecedented encounters.

Discover the legendary Dan Capps Exhibit, one of the world’s most remarkable insect collections, guided personally by Dan himself. Gain rare insights and captivating stories behind his meticulously curated specimens, bringing scientific wonders vividly to life.

Outside the exhibit, roam freely through a virtual garden, casually uncovering hidden insects and reptiles as you explore. Ideal for educators looking for compelling, hands-on teaching tools, insect and reptile enthusiasts craving deeper insights; and anyone seeking awe-inspiring experiences, Creepy Crawly Zoo 2.0 provides hours of immersive exploration and unmatched educational value.

Prepare yourself for wild adventures, fascinating science, and unforgettable discoveries—one virtual step at a time!
